items.item_text: Maintain District standards of excellent customer service and professional behavior in various and sometimes challenging situations.
Access and monitor District email daily to receive important updates from school and District administration.
Participate in staff development and in-service training programs as assigned.
Work with children who may have unique health concerns and/or learning styles.
Plan, design, and coordinate the operation of a childcare program designed to meet the needs of elementary school-aged children.

Create appropriate room organization; design and implement a schedule of activities appropriate to the goals of the program that hold the interest of elementary school-aged students. Perform weekly planning for morning kindergarten and afternoon program with age-appropriate activities, initiate contact with parents on a daily basis.
Assist students with homework assignments; design and implement behavior modification and reinforcement systems.

Establish and maintain files and records related to the program, such as new registrations and attendance and enrollment reports. Perform operational activities and monitor authorization of persons to sign students in and out.
Set up work areas, displays and exhibits; operate audio-visual equipment; operate educational training equipment and distribute s and collect s papers and supplies.
Assist in rendering various forms of personal care such as toileting, diapering, dressing, undressing, bathing, and grooming.
Plan and prepare snacks within nutritional and budget limitations; prepare weekly snack menu for parents.
Maintain a monthly budget for supplies and orders supplies when needed.
Organize and coordinate fundraisers with school site and supervisor; maintain communication with supervisor of site activities ; and assist supervisor in training personnel.
Lead childcare activities; explain aspects of the program to parents and the public and interpret policies and procedures with regard to program operation.
Participate in staff development and in-service training programs as assigned.
